name: Pixie Robe
desc: A robe colored like a fairy. Light yet warm, this is a favorite among adventurers. However, the vivid fabric makes it impossible for the wearer to blend into their surroundings.

eff.name: Fairy's Whisper
eff.desc1: Boosts DEF by [Lv. x 3]%. Raises Negative Effect resistance by [Lv. x 3]% while in the outer range.

eff.name: Fickle Favor
eff.desc1: Restores HP by [Lv. x 1]% when an action is taken.

eff.name: HP Regeneration
eff.desc1: Continuously restores HP by [Lv. x 1]% at a set interval.
